steps.code:
# Parse the lines with TODO to extract song title and artists
import re
todo_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        m = re.match(r'^- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT TODO$', line)
        if m:
            title = m.group(1).strip()
            artists_str = m.group(2).strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            todo_lines.append({'line': line, 'title': title, 'artists': artists})
            print(f"Title: {title}, Artists: {artists}")
        else:
            print(f"Could not parse: {line}")

# Search for each song to get release date
for item in todo_lines:
    query = item['title'] + ' ' + ' '.join(item['artists'])
    result = apis.spotify.search_songs(access_token=spotify_login['access_token'], query=query)
    # Find the matching song
    found = None
    for song in result:
        song_artists = [a['name'] for a in song['artists']]
        if song['title'].lower() == item['title'].lower() and set(song_artists) == set(item['artists']):
            found = song
            break
    if found:
        release_date = found['release_date']
        # Extract month and year
        month = release_date[5:7]
        year = release_date[0:4]
        item['release_month'] = f"{month}/{year}"
        print(f"{item['title']} -> {item['release_month']}")
